description: Union trades carpenters sequence: read the drawing and pull dimensions, lay the wall out on the floor, cut and frame the section square with headers over openings, stand it plumb, level and braced, then inspect against the punch list. Aligned to regional carpenter training programmes (Nor Cal Carpenters Training — alignment from the 2026-11-10 industry pass, not a partnership). Simulation only — not certification, not licensure, not an apprenticeship credential.

halls.note: No hall mapped. Hall mapping is open (Phase 4). The 111-hall roster in the SmartCiti.X bundle is an in-repo list; 0 of 111 signed off by a named practitioner — a named hall is not a partner.

objectives: Pull dimensions from a drawing into a cut list
Lay out a wall section on the floor, plates marked for studs and openings
Frame a section square, with headers over openings
Stand, plumb, level and brace the section
Inspect against a punch list and log what remains

stations.title: Layout floor — drawings, chalk line, plates
Inspection point — square, level, punch list

steps.action: Read the drawing and pull the dimensions for one wall section into a cut list.
Lay the wall out on the floor: snap the lines and mark the plates for studs, jacks and openings.
Cut and assemble: frame the section square, with headers over every opening.
Stand the section, then plumb, level and brace it.
steps.check: Plumb and level within tolerance; braced.

steps.action: Inspect the section against the punch list, log anything left, and debrief with the coach.
steps.check: Punch list cleared or logged; debrief complete.
